title: Revise a Proposal Without Inventing Agreement
status: New proposed Lesson 04 production script, 2026-10-29. No new animation or narration in this handoff.
learningOutcome: Revise a proposal in response to a specific concern and record only the agreement actually expressed, leaving unanswered questions visible.

scenario.task: Plan how a group will use an answer-help tool during a twenty-minute practice session with two sample problems. The aim is to understand the key reasoning, not merely finish answers.
conditions: The fictional tool can offer a hint or a worked answer
Tool output is not independently verified
scenario.baselineQuote: An answer tool can save time when we get stuck. I would use it as soon as a problem becomes difficult.
scenario.scope: No institution, official test, observed learner performance or measured outcome is represented. S07 transfers to a new event-notice layout discussion. The baseline quote does not specify whether the help is a hint or a full answer.

blocks.title: Change the Part That Needs Changing
Record the Agreement You Actually Hear

L04.S05.c001.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c001.text: A comparison can reveal a condition your proposal does not handle. You do not have to abandon everything, or insist that the first version was perfect. Identify the condition, then decide what would need to change.
L04.S05.c001.visualEn: Open with a proposal card and one editable condition, not a winner and loser. The formal board carries the explanation.
L04.S05.c001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c001.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.c002.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c002.text: The group still has twenty minutes and two sample problems. A brief attempt before a focused hint is under discussion. The session has not run, and no plan has been adopted. Now listen to a possible concern about getting started.
L04.S05.c002.visualEn: Re-establish fixed facts and the unadopted proposal. Mark the following character exchange Authored example.
L04.S05.c002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c002.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.d001.speaker: maya
L04.S05.d001.text: What if someone cannot find a first step? Waiting before asking for help might use up time without helping them understand.
L04.S05.d001.visualEn: Brief Maya appearance. Put the conditional difficulty inside an If frame; do not depict an actual participant failing or waiting.
L04.S05.d001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.d001.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S05.c003.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c003.text: This concern is about access to a starting point. It does not show that the person is unwilling to think, and it does not prove that immediate full answers are always better. Keep the specific difficulty in view.
L04.S05.c003.visualEn: Remove unsupported personality and universal-outcome claims from a neutral annotation area, retaining the exact conditional concern.
L04.S05.c003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c003.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.c004.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c004.text: One revision would make the support conditional on what the person needs, rather than requiring an attempt before any hint. Listen for what changes and what remains uncertain.
L04.S05.c004.visualEn: Create a comparison with Original proposal and Possible revision, sharing the same goal. Do not introduce a timer or a new minute allocation.
L04.S05.c004.anchorHint: requiring an attempt before any hint
L04.S05.c004.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c004.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.d002.speaker: learner
L04.S05.d002.text: Could we try a first step when we can, but ask for a focused starting hint if we cannot identify one? We would still need to explain and check what the tool suggests.
L04.S05.d002.visualEn: Show a conditional route for starting difficulty alongside a first-attempt route. Both lead to checking, without success or agreement badges.
L04.S05.d002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.d002.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S05.c005.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c005.text: The revision changes when a hint may be requested. It keeps attention on reasoning and checking. That makes it responsive to the concern, but not automatically the best plan. A focused hint could still be insufficient, misleading, or difficult to verify.
L04.S05.c005.visualEn: Return to the formal board and highlight the changed condition only. Show unresolved limits without presenting a generic compromise as the winner.
L04.S05.c005.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c005.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.d003.speaker: maya
L04.S05.d003.text: I support allowing a starting hint. What would we do if the hint still does not help?
L04.S05.d003.visualEn: A brief explicitly authored continuation. Split Maya’s exact words into one supported feature and one unanswered question. No group nodding or approval sound.
L04.S05.d003.anchorHint: I support allowing a starting hint
L04.S05.d003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.d003.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S05.c006.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c006.text: In this written example, Maya supports one feature: allowing a starting hint. She has also asked a question. Neither statement means that everyone agrees with the whole plan. Do not turn partial agreement into a group decision.
L04.S05.c006.visualEn: Use a three-part status board: Explicitly supported, Still open, Not established. Keep speaker attribution on the supported item.
L04.S05.c006.anchorHint: Do not turn partial agreement into a group decision
L04.S05.c006.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c006.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.c007.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c007.text: A suggestion does not become agreed because nobody objects immediately. Silence may leave us unsure what others think. Ask which part they support or question, and record only the response they actually give.
L04.S05.c007.visualEn: Keep silent participants visually neutral or offstage. Use an open response space, not an inferred yes, dislike, confusion or reluctance.
L04.S05.c007.anchorHint: record only the response they actually give
L04.S05.c007.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c007.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.d004.speaker: learner
L04.S05.d004.text: We have one point of support about a starting hint. We still need to discuss what happens if it is not enough, and hear the other views.
L04.S05.d004.visualEn: Show an attributed summary of the exact exchange. It remains a model, not a system-generated summary of real learner speech.
L04.S05.d004.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.d004.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S05.c008.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c008.text: The next question could be when to examine a worked answer, or how to check a disputed step. Keep both within the twenty-minute session. More help also takes time; do not invent extra time or treat tool output as a verified answer.
L04.S05.c008.visualEn: Keep an undivided twenty-minute boundary around two open questions. Do not choose a solution or show the session as completed.
L04.S05.c008.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c008.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.c009.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c009.text: Privately choose one unresolved issue and form a question about it. Leave out claims that everybody agrees or that the new plan will work. You are inviting examination, not announcing the result.
L04.S05.c009.visualEn: Hide previous question models. Retain the actual unresolved issue and an empty private area.
L04.S05.c009.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c009.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.d005.speaker: learner
L04.S05.d005.text: If a hint is not enough, what would make a worked answer useful for understanding the next step?
L04.S05.d005.visualEn: Introduce this as One possible question in a separate model area, leaving the private area blank.
L04.S05.d005.anchorHint: useful for understanding the next step
L04.S05.d005.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.d005.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S05.c010.speaker: coach
L04.S05.c010.text: A revision can address a concern while leaving a real decision open. Keep the change, the expressed support, and the unanswered question separate. That gives the group an accurate basis for continuing, without inventing consensus.
L04.S05.c010.visualEn: End on three clearly differentiated status cards. No solved badge, guaranteed cooperation, course navigation or adopted plan.
L04.S05.c010.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S05.c010.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S05.h101.purpose: Identify the condition that a revised proposal needs to handle.
L04.S05.h101.visualEn: Keep the exact concern and original proposal visible. Do not reveal the upcoming revision yet.

L04.S05.h102.purpose: Privately form a next question about the unresolved proposal.
L04.S05.h102.visualEn: No recording, generated learner answer, forced gate or implied completion.

boundary: Use formal explanation and short examples. No perpetual three-person scene; no school, exam, policy or assessed-learner claim.
